seo.title: Temp Easy — Body Temperature Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Track body temperature for the whole family. Log readings, see trends with fever alerts, and export reports for your doctor. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: TEMPERATURE TRACKER
hero.title: Track temperature, for the whole family.
text: Log readings, monitor symptoms, and share reports with your doctor. All your family's health data stays on your device — no accounts, no cloud sync, no subscriptions.

items.title: Multi-Person Profiles
items.text: Create profiles for each family member with custom fever thresholds by age. Track everyone's temperature in one app.

items.title: Trend Charts
items.text: Visualize temperature changes over time with beautiful charts. Track up to 30 readings per person to spot patterns and recovery.

items.title: Symptom Tracking
items.text: Log symptoms alongside each reading — headache, cough, fatigue, and more. See the full picture of how everyone's feeling.

items.title: Medication Logging
items.text: Record medications and doses with timestamps. Keep track of what was given and when, especially useful for children's medicine.

items.title: Export for Doctors
items.text: Generate CSV or text reports with all readings, symptoms, and medications. Share via email or print for your next doctor's visit.

items.title: HealthKit Sync
items.text: Optionally sync with Apple Health. Read existing temperature data or write new readings. Your health data stays unified in one place.

sections.label: FEVER THRESHOLDS
sections.title: Know when to worry.
text: Temperature readings are color-coded based on standard medical guidelines for fever detection.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your family's health data stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Your temperature readings and health information are stored locally on your device. We never see them, and neither does anyone else.

cta.title: Start tracking.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
